correctness.rationale: For positive rates on an n>=3 one-way cycle, s=h/2, the resolvent R=(I-sQ)^-1 has R_ii=1/[(1+sr_i)(1-Pi(s))], Pi=prod_j sr_j/(1+sr_j), and positive offdiagonals. C=2R-I. The minimum diagonal is at maximum-rate M. Multiplying 2R_pp-1 by the positive common denominator gives H_p(s)=sum_k(a_k-Ma_{k-1})s^k, whose coefficients change sign once by Newton-log-concavity of elementary-symmetric ratios and whose final nonzero term is negative. Descartes and endpoint signs force exactly one simple positive crossing, so positivity holds precisely h<=2s*. Raising any other rate raises return probability and the threshold; the homogeneous equal-M vector attains the sharp upper envelope, and one rate tending zero approaches lower infimum 2/M. Independently expanded the prior published threshold F(s) and submitted H(s) for (1,2,4,7), obtaining identical -90s³-35s²+1; this is direct scientific coverage evidence.
